headings.rules: Never use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings.

body.style: leading-relaxed, highly legible for dashboards and CV reading

colors.strategy: CSS Variable Driven (Admin Themeable) - Default Base: Swiss High-Contrast
rules: No generic full-screen gradients. Use flat or highly structural grayscale backgrounds.
Primary color MUST be injected via CSS variables so the Admin can customize it dynamically.
Use status color-coding consistently across candidate and admin views.
Do NOT use teal green/blue (#1B93A4) or #7351B7 anywhere.

surface_styles: Glassmorphism (Crystal Variant): For sticky headers, AI chat overlays. bg-white/70, backdrop-blur-xl, 1px border-white/20. NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds.
Neumorphism (Tactile): For dashboard action cards. Flat background, sharp 1px border-black/5, layered shadow.
Grid Borders: For admin dashboard data tables. border-collapse, subtle borders.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlays on the landing page hero section to kill digital flatness.

component_name.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea. Do not use native HTML inputs.
component_name.select: Shadcn Select for job categories and status filters.
component_name.tables: Shadcn Table for candidate management in Admin dashboard.
component_name.dialogs: Shadcn Dialog for viewing CVs and application details.
component_name.voice_recorder: Custom UI using standard audio web APIs, styled with a distinct pulse animation when active.
component_name.tabs: Shadcn Tabs (override h-9 to h-auto) for switching between Admin Chat and AI Settings.

grids.landing_page: Tetris Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps, asymmetrical).
grids.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4, tight gaps, strict hierarchy).
grids.rules: Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers. Add p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision.

layouts.public_facing: Large expressive headers, asymmetrical feature grids, immersive sticky navigation.
layouts.candidate_portal: Top navigation, modular cards showing job applications and status timeline.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Left-sidebar navigation (collapsible). Top-left KPI snapshot. Actionable tasks widget. Main center is the candidate pipeline table.

motion.interactions: Hover states (translate-y-1, shadow-lg, text color change) on all cards.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-transform, opacity (NOT transition-all).
motion.voice_recording: Pulsing red dot or audio waveform animation when recording is active.
motion.chat: Smooth entrance animations for new messages (framer-motion slide up).

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard minimums. Dynamic text color inversion if admin chooses a light primary color.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 on all inputs and buttons.

media.handling: Images max-h-[80vh] on mobile. Overlay hero images with bg-black/40 max.

3d_libraries.usage: Use Framer Motion for UI transitions. No heavy 3D required unless adding a subtle particle background on the landing page (TSParticles).

landing_hero.description: Modern office space for landing page background (apply bg-black/40 overlay)

company_logo.description: Minimalist startup logo stand-in for platform brand or hiring company

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure complete separation of Candidate and Admin routes (e.g., /dashboard for candidates, /admin for admins).
Implement a dynamic CSS variable mechanism allowing the admin to override --primary and --primary-foreground.
For the voice recording feature, build a custom UI block inside the application form with a clear timer (max 10:00) and 'Start/Stop/Playback' controls.
Build a persistent Chat Widget on candidate side that toggles between AI Assistant and Admin Live Chat.
You are working with .js files, NOT .tsx. Adapt all Shadcn and React component definitions to standard JavaScript (JSX) without TypeScript types.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for professional dashboard iconography.
Use sonner for all toast notifications (status updates, theme changes, application submitted).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Do not make generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and chat windows. Never use pure transparent backgrounds if content scrolls underneath.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties like transition-transform or opacity.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use real SVG icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Apply optical alignment over strict geometric alignment where appropriate.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Every interactive element MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-application-btn') to facilitate robust automated testing.
Status badges MUST be visibly distinct: Pending (Yellow/Orange), Accepted (Green), Rejected (Red).
Empty states in the admin dashboard (no applicants yet) should have actionable CTAs ('Post a new job').
Provide clear feedback (sonner toasts) for destructive actions (e.g., deleting a candidate or rejecting an application).
Ensure the voice recording UI clearly indicates recording state (pulsing UI) and length to prevent user anxiety.
